cause.binding_constraint: the cross-asset term added nothing over what the target's own history already explained
cause.mechanism_reading: the universe's trailing correlation with the equal-weight market is 0.89-0.92 with betas of 0.67 (BTC), 1.02 (ETH) and 1.19 (SOL): co-movement dominates, which is why knowing the leader's move adds nothing once the target's own move is controlled
cause.note: the best cell's cross-asset arm grossed +1.865037 bps while its own-history baseline grossed +0.025195 bps, so the external information was worth +1.839842 bps against a frozen hurdle of 40.056845 bps and a round-trip cost of 23.790569 bps
cause.selection_null_note: an equally sized random signal of the same shape reached +3.524387 bps at the 95th percentile of the best-of-N null, above the +1.865037 bps actually observed

environment_constraint.warning_threshold_basis: 2 GiB free is the level at which the tests that compare real free space begin to flake (documented during ALPHA-002); below it a run can be refused by the allocator
